name: Navigate independent consultancy pages and service details
description: Verifies the main navigation opens independent routes and a service card leads to its dedicated detail page.
steps: Select Services in the primary navigation
expected: The Services overview and service detail render at their own URLs after navigation and refresh.

name: Filter store research and open an attributed case study
description: Verifies portfolio filters narrow the collection and a selected store opens a dedicated analysis page with source attribution.
steps: Open the official store link in a new tab
expected: The matching store card is visible, the case-study route shows research attribution, and the official store link opens separately.

name: Search and read a dedicated blog article on mobile
description: Verifies mobile navigation and blog discovery lead to a readable standalone article page.
expected: The article opens at its own URL and remains readable after refresh without horizontal overflow.

name: Submit and validate a project inquiry
description: Verifies the contact page blocks incomplete submissions and accepts a complete inquiry through the existing backend.
steps: Attempt submission with required fields empty
Complete name, valid business email, stage, improvement area and project description
expected: The browser blocks incomplete fields; a complete submission shows the existing backend confirmation and email-delivery status.
